title: seq-triage pipeline parameters
description: Detect sequencing platform, validate metadata, route QC, summarise

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Where the samplesheet comes from and where results go.

input.description: Samplesheet CSV: one row per sample, columns sample, fastq_1, fastq_2, platform, sample_type.
input.help_text: fastq_2, platform and sample_type are optional. Leave platform blank to have it detected from the reads.

outdir.description: Directory for results. Created if it does not exist.

metric_guide.description: TSV of metric definitions and warn/fail thresholds used by the summary report.
metric_guide.help_text: Defaults to assets/metric_guide.tsv. Supply your own to apply local thresholds without editing the pipeline.

publish_dir_mode.description: How results are written to outdir.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: copy is the default so that deleting work/ never empties results/.
